title: The physics of optical computing
role: Physical advantages, limitations, and system integration of optical computation; not a sorting benchmark.

authors: Andrés Macho-Ortiz, Daniel Pérez-López, José Azaña, José Capmany
title: Analog Programmable-Photonic Computation
role: Anbits, programmable linear gates, and feedback as APC foundations; classical optical processing, not a Q.ANT API specification.

title: Area-Time Complexity for VLSI
role: Physical area-time trade-offs and communication; the DFT bound is not adopted as a sorting bound.

title: Space-Time Complexity in Optical Computing
role: Spatial, temporal, and fan-in resources limit simple claims of constant optical execution time.

title: The spatial complexity of optical computing: toward space-efficient design
role: Space requirements of linear operators and nonlocal communication; applicability to complete nonlinear sorting is limited.

title: Sorting Networks and Their Applications
role: Basis of fixed Bitonic stages and comparison counts; not a physical timing model.

authors: Charles W. Stirk, Ravindra A. Athale
title: Sorting with optical compare-and-exchange modules
role: Spatial C&E pipeline, implementation variants, and regeneration; starting point for the active Bitonic adaptation.

authors: F. R. Beyette, Jr., P. A. Mitkas, S. A. Feld, C. W. Wilmsen
title: Bitonic sorting using an optoelectronic recirculating architecture
role: Reuse of smart-pixel arrays; distinguishes complete response time from output interval.

authors: M. P. Y. Desmulliez et al.
title: Perfect-shuffle interconnected bitonic sorter: optoelectronic design
role: Perfect shuffle, control masks, and bit-serial cycles; not an additional modern SDK hardware experiment.

authors: Ahmed Louri, James A. Hatch, Jr., Jongwhoa Na
title: Constant-time parallel sorting algorithm and its optical implementation using smart pixels
role: Broadcast-and-compare, rank construction, and ties; constant number of wide layers with quadratic resources.

title: In-network stable radix sorter using many FPGAs with high-bandwidth photonics [Invited]
role: FPGA/HBM sorting with photonic links; eight-FPGA measurements and a separate scaling projection.

title: Universal photonic artificial intelligence acceleration
role: Integrated hybrid accelerator illustrating digital peripherals and conversion costs; not a Q.ANT system.

title: Digital-analog hybrid matrix multiplication processor for optical neural networks
role: Hybrid precision improvement for matrix operations; additional digital work must be counted.

title: Efficient hardware error correction with hybrid on-offline configuration algorithm for optical processor
role: Calibration through offline/online configuration; motivates separate treatment of systematic errors.

authors: Huize Li, Dan Chen, Tulika Mitra
title: Hybrid Photonic-digital Accelerator for Attention Mechanism (HyAtten)
role: Selective digital processing with limited analog precision; a possible direction, not implemented in the sorter code.

title: Integrated lithium niobate photonic computing circuit based on efficient and high-speed electro-optic conversion
role: TFLN-based modulation and computation; no evidence of freely cascaded Q.ANT functions.

title: LightMat-HP: A Photonic–Electronic System for Accelerating General Matrix Multiplication With Configurable Precision
role: Low-bit photonic partial products and digital reconstruction; the DOI placeholder in the supplied version is not used as publication evidence.

title: Photonic analog-to-digital conversion by use of nonlinear Fabry–Perot resonators
role: Nonlinear optical conversion as an alternative component; does not provide parameters for the hardware used here.

authors: Nathaniel Nauman, James Robinson, Yuyang Wang, Kaylx Jang, Xiang Meng, Keren Bergman
title: Photonic Analog-to-Digital Architecture for Accelerating Multiply-Accumulate Operations
source: Individual PDF 14; OFC 2025, W3D.5, additionally checked with the publisher
role: Photonic ADC architecture for MAC; motivates the converter interface, not a Q.ANT measurement.

title: Progress in silicon-based reconfigurable and programmable all-optical signal processing chips
role: Review of programmable signal processing and regeneration; functional diversity requires specific components.

authors: Raúl López-March, Andrés Macho-Ortiz, Francisco Javier Fraile-Peláez, José Capmany
title: Noise in analog programmable-photonic computation
role: Physical noise sources and error propagation; example values belong to that PIP arrangement and are not a Q.ANT calibration.

authors: Niklas Bahr, Daniel Steinmeyer, Wolfram Pernice
title: Energy Efficiency in Analog Photonic Processors: Conversions and Losses at Scale
source: Individual PDF 23; image-based version, additionally read using OCR
role: System cost model for conversion, weights, memory, and losses; excludes digital control logic and does not establish sorting energy use.

title: PRISM: Photonic Similarity Engine for KV Cache Block Selection in Long-Context LLM Inference
source: Individual PDF 21; v2 of 25 March 2026 with supplement
role: Photonic scoring and electronic selection; application motivation for recall, not complete stable integer sorting.

title: Analogue vs. Digital Computers—A Comparison
role: Historical distinction between analog and digital computing principles; not a quantitative modern hardware baseline.

authors: Guo Qi Zhang, Alfred van Roosmalen (eds.)
title: More than Moore: Creating High Value Micro/Nanoelectronics Systems
role: Technological context beyond transistor scaling; not a separate sorting or photonics experiment.

title: Why future supercomputing requires optics
role: Motivation for optical communication and parallelism; a forward-looking argument, not evidence for this workload.

title: High-performance analog signal processing with photonic integrated circuits
source: Research compilation 01, starting on p. 18; commentary
role: Context for integrated analog signal processing; the commentary and primary demonstrators it discusses remain distinct.

title: Photonic matrix multiplication lights up photonic accelerator and beyond
source: Research compilation 01, starting on p. 19; presentation literature
role: Review of matrix multiplication using spatial, interferometric, and wavelength-based methods; context for MVM.

authors: P. Bruce Berra, Arif Ghafoor, Pericles A. Mitkas, Slawomir J. Marcinkowski, Mohsen Guizani
title: The Impact of Optics on Data and Knowledge Base Systems
role: Early context for optical database operations and data movement; not a directly comparable current measurement.

title: A Reliability Concern on Photonic Neural Networks
role: Architecture-specific reliability and crosstalk; not a universal mode-count or noise limit for Q.ANT.

authors: Bibliographic entry from the research compilation
title: Integrated PCM-based DAC/ADC Design for Energy-Efficient Photonic Computing Systems
source: Research compilation 01, starting on p. 108; analysis notes
role: PCM-based conversion as another approach; not separately reproduced. Percentage savings in the notes are not adopted as our own findings or Q.ANT results.

authors: Nikolaos Farmakidis, Bowei Dong, Harish Bhaskaran
title: Integrated photonic neuromorphic computing: opportunities and challenges
role: Systematic classification of hybrid neural photonics and interfaces; motivates complete execution boundaries.

authors: M. A. Al-Qadasi, L. Chrostowski, B. J. Shastri, S. Shekhar
title: Scaling Up Silicon Photonic-Based Accelerators: Challenges and Opportunities
source: Research compilation 01, starting on p. 377; preprint 2109.08025
role: Optical and electrical link budgets, scaling, and energy costs; parameters must match the specific setup.

title: Analog nanophotonic computing going practical: silicon photonic deep learning engines for tiled optical matrix multiplication with dynamic precision
role: Tiling and dynamic precision as system methods; no automatic guarantee of exact comparison decisions.

title: Quantum Nonlinearity for Optical Neural Computing
source: Research compilation 01, starting on p. 413; current arXiv entry additionally checked
role: Quantum-emitter nonlinearity in a different architecture; not equivalent to classical APC or an available Q.ANT cascade path.

title: Q.ANT Native Computing Toolkit: pinned source version
source: Official SDK source version; checksums and CPU package included in the project
role: API contracts, BF16 formats, host ReLU, and the CPU/hardware distinction; not a fully open hardware driver.

title: Photonic Computing: product information
source: Official product page; supplemented by the June 2026 Generation 2 brochure
role: Manufacturer statements on interface, performance, and product; not our own comparator, transfer-characteristic, or sorting measurements.

title: numpy.argsort and numpy.take_along_axis
source: Official API documentation; installed benchmark version 2.3.5
role: Stable indirect sorting and gathering original values; numerical timing results come exclusively from our saved measurements.

title: scipy.stats.kendalltau
source: Official statistics documentation; independent implementation check
role: Definition and tie correction of Kendall-τ-b; does not replace separate validity and stability metrics.

title: Analog Photonics Computing for Information Processing, Inference and Optimisation
source: Presentation P2, p. 25; arXiv entry additionally checked
role: Review of analog photonic platforms, optimization, and inference. The presentation must not infer universally error-free physical sorting from it.
